label: The Meditator
tagline: A reactive surface that treats silence as silence
cluster_explainer: Practitioners read the engine for what it does to attention over time, with zero tolerance for popups or nudges.
demo_highlights: High smooth_factor (0.9) absorbs transients so the visual breathes instead of twitches
Bass-band coupling reads the slow chest-and-belly register that grounds a sitting
Smoke preset is the quietest available style — minimal color push, no gimmicks, no scores
Icosahedron at low rotation holds a perceptual object that the eye can release without losing its place
Engine idle state is itself part of the demo: long pauses between events must read as silence, not a glitch
